title: Paginate the admin audit log
body:
Large orgs have tens of thousands of audit entries and the admin console's audit tab was rendering all of them at once, which locked up the browser.

- `GET /admin/audit` now takes `page` (1-based, the number shown under the table) and `pageSize` (default 50, capped at 200).
- The response keeps `entries` and adds `page`, `pageSize`, `totalPages` and `totalEntries` so the console can draw the pager.

The console change is in a separate PR.
